cd /code && Rscript -e 'library(tidyverse); ds<-read_csv("/data/summary_stats_LSS2.csv", na="NaN"); ds<-ds %>% filter(id != 212 & id != 203); cat("LSS2 walking speed medians
"); print(ds %>% gather(task, speed, walk_path_speed, search_path_speed) %>% group_by(task) %>% summarise(median=median(speed, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")); cat("LSS2 straightness medians
"); print(ds %>% gather(task, speed, walk_straightness, search_straightness) %>% group_by(task) %>% summarise(median=median(speed, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")); ds1<-read_csv("/data/summary_stats_LSS1.csv", na="NaN") %>% filter(id != 35); cat("LSS1 walking speed medians
"); print(ds1 %>% gather(task, speed, walk_path_speed, search_path_speed) %>% group_by(task) %>% summarise(median=median(speed, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")); cat("LSS1 straightness medians
"); print(ds1 %>% gather(task, speed, walk_straightness, search_straightness) %>% group_by(task) %>% summarise(median=median(speed, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop"));' > /results/medians.txt 2>&1 && sed -n '1,200p' /results/medians.txt
